analysis:
Only CHANGELOG.md changed: a single added 'Unreleased' entry (head patch hunk @@ -1,4 +1,8 @@, new lines 3-5). It says the provider will process App Attest challenges, authorization updates and connection invalidation while inference or model work is suspended, while keeping model-work ordering and existing proof, expiry, key-reuse and revocation checks. No source code, config or tests are included in this PR batch. The entry is documentation only and introduces no security behavior by itself. The base file (CHANGELOG.md lines 1-426) was read as context; none of it is changed.

Relevant threats if the described code ships elsewhere: T-053 (stale authorization or replayed proof surviving connection change or revocation), T-052, T-057 (App Attest recovery and availability), T-056 and TB-011. The changelog claims the existing proof, expiry, key-reuse and revocation checks are retained. That claim cannot be verified from this diff because the provider-side implementation is not supplied. Concurrency changes to the provider message loop (handling App Attest frames during suspended inference) would need review of three things: ordering of invalidation versus in-flight dispatch, no extension of grants while work is suspended, and the final-dispatch connection and endpoint binding. Unchanged callers were not examined.

No findings. Coverage limit: the implementing source is absent, so nothing about the described behavior is confirmed.
